items.title: CHORUS: A proteome-scale atlas of membrane interaction interfaces constructed using cross-protein language model embeddings from sequences alone
items.abstract_or_text: Membrane proteins drive vital cellular signaling and bioenergetics yet resolving their physical interaction interfaces remains hindered by the paucity of experimental complexes and the breakdown of sequence alignments across hydrophobic bilayers. Here, we present CHORUS, a sequence-only deep-learning framework that decodes interaction sites across membrane proteins without requiring 3D structures, multiple sequence alignments (MSAs), or predefined partner identities. By systematically synthesizing complementary latent representations across diverse protein language model (pLM) families and functional layer depths, CHORUS outperforms 18 established sequence- and structure-based methods across 4,655 homology-isolated test contexts (average precision: 0.643), demonstrating amplified predictive capacity within the lipid-embedded core (0.746). We show that CHORUS delineates quaternary contact boundaries across megadalton respiratory supercomplexes directly from sequences alone (0.984). We deliver the CHORUS Atlas (https://chorus.atlas.sunnylab.org), providing precomputed, residue-resolved interaction landscapes for 80,619 reviewed transmembrane proteins spanning 4,918 species and 33.7 million residues to empower interactome-scale discovery and allosteric therapeutic design.

items.why_it_matters_zh: 在缺乏实验复合物、序列比对和三维结构时仍能预测膜内接触界面，并在4,655个同源隔离测试情境中超过18种既有方法；大规模Atlas为互作组发现和变构药物设计提供了可复用资源。摘要未说明实验验证的具体类型，预测性能仍可能受数据分布和模型外推限制。
items.abstract_zh: 膜蛋白驱动重要的细胞信号传导和生物能量过程，但由于实验复合物稀缺以及疏水双层中序列比对失效，解析其物理相互作用界面仍然受限。在此，我们提出CHORUS，这是一种仅基于序列的深度学习框架，无需3D结构、多序列比对（MSA）或预先指定的互作伙伴，即可解析膜蛋白上的相互作用位点。通过系统整合不同蛋白语言模型（pLM）家族和功能层深度的互补潜在表示，CHORUS在4,655个同源隔离测试情境中超过18种既有的序列和结构方法（平均精确率为0.643），并在脂质嵌入核心区域表现出更高的预测能力（0.746）。我们展示了CHORUS能够仅从序列直接描绘兆道尔顿级呼吸超复合体中的四级接触边界（0.984）。我们发布了CHORUS Atlas（https://chorus.atlas.sunnylab.org），为覆盖4,918个物种的80,619种经审核跨膜蛋白、共计3,370万残基提供预计算的残基分辨率相互作用图谱，以支持互作组尺度的发现和变构治疗设计。

items.abstract_or_text: New Amazon paper shows that an LLM can act as a research world model, predicting whether a training change will help before anyone spends GPU time on it. AI research agents can propose experiments far faster than teams can afford to run them. Choosing what gets GPU time means guessing outcomes in advance. They used an LLM as a research world model that predicts an experiment's gain before it runs. They tested it on 2,653 real experiment records from 9 setups, from pretraining to inference. Past records from the same setup raised average ranking correlation with actual results from 0.506 to 0.774 across 5 setups. On the OLMo3-100M setup, adding records at low reasoning effort scored 0.892, while max effort without records reached 0.648. If you run research agents, log every experiment, including failures, and feed those records to whatever model picks the next run.
items.summary_zh: 事实：Rohan Paul 转述亚马逊研究，研究者用大型语言模型预测训练改动在实际运行前可能带来的收益。作者称，该方法在2653条、9个设置的真实实验记录上测试，并在5个设置中将平均排名相关性从0.506提高到0.774。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这为自动化AI研究提供了可量化的实验筛选机制，也强调了记录失败实验对后续决策的重要性。

items.title: CP-GFM-SGX: Topology-Aware Cyclic Peptide Generation and Design with Receptor-Conditioned Structural Evaluation and Experimental KRAS Affinity Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Cyclic-peptide discovery requires molecular topology, atomic structure, receptor-associated evidence and computational decisions to remain consistent across a multistage workflow. We present CP-GFM-SGX, an all-atom generative AI model for cyclic-peptide design that integrates a topology-aware generative core with a Unified Evidence State Machine (UESM) to track candidate identity, chemical validity, provenance, typed failures and bounded computation. We evaluated three distinct aspects of the system. In Track A, a frozen five-complex known-ligand benchmark with 100 scheduled poses per complex, the native-free FULL route selected a ligand-backbone pose with root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) below 2 Å in four of five systems; retrospective best-of-100 evaluation found a sub-2-Å pose in all five (median selected RMSD, 1.72 Å). In Track B, matched true-pocket versus shuffled-pocket comparisons favored the specified pocket in all seven main targets (median of target medians, +172.6 Rosetta energy units; weakest margin, +3.9 for MCL-1–9CDT). An exploratory post-protocol assessor admitted 42/42, 42/42 and 40/42 selected top-K slots in the full, condition-masked and post hoc head-to-tail arms, respectively. In Track C, FULL UESM produced the specified protective outcomes for six deterministic synthetic fault fixtures and one additional missing-evidence case; targeted ablations isolated the roles of provenance and failure propagation. In a separate KRAS G12D–GDP experimental-feedback series, synthesis and SPR/BLI testing of cyclic-peptide analogues guided position-2 basic-side-chain selection and dual-basic-group placement, advancing the reported SPR affinity from approximately 60 µM for CRO-748 to approximately 6 µM for 748-R1 and approximately 1 µM for 748-RK. Comparisons using the 31-dimension Structured Capability and Evidence Grid (SCEG-31D) demonstrate that CP-GFM-SGX exhibits certain superiority over other design platforms in multiple aspects. Together, we evaluate a topology-aware generative artificial intelligence workflow for receptor-focused cyclic-peptide design and show, in a KRAS feedback series, how binding measurements guide iterative chemical optimization.
items.summary_zh: 提出面向受体的拓扑感知环肽生成系统CP-GFM-SGX，将全原子生成模型与Unified Evidence State Machine（UESM）结合，并通过结构基准、故障注入测试及KRAS G12D实验反馈验证设计流程。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把分子拓扑、受体口袋、证据溯源和失败传播纳入同一工作流，并用SPR/BLI反馈将CRO-748的报告亲和力从约60 μM优化到748-R1的约6 μM和748-RK的约1 μM。需要注意的是，研究为ChemRxiv预印本，部分评估为回顾性或探索性测试，平台间比较的普适性仍需独立实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 环肽发现要求在多阶段工作流中保持分子拓扑、原子结构、受体相关证据和计算决策的一致性。我们提出CP-GFM-SGX，这是一种用于环肽设计的全原子生成式AI模型，将拓扑感知生成核心与Unified Evidence State Machine（UESM）结合，用于跟踪候选物身份、化学有效性、来源、类型化失败以及有界计算。我们评估了该系统的三个不同方面。在Track A中，针对五个复合物的冻结已知配体基准，每个复合物安排100个姿势；无天然配体信息的FULL路线在五个体系中的四个体系中选出了配体-骨架均方根偏差（RMSD）低于2 Å的姿势；回顾性最佳100个姿势评估则在全部五个体系中都找到了低于2 Å的姿势（选定姿势的RMSD中位数为1.72 Å）。在Track B中，匹配的真实口袋与打乱口袋比较在七个主要靶点中均偏向指定口袋（各靶点中位数的中位数为+172.6 Rosetta能量单位；最弱差值为MCL-1–9CDT的+3.9）。探索性的协议后评估器在full、condition-masked和post hoc head-to-tail三组中分别接纳了42/42、42/42和40/42个选定的top-K位置。在Track C中，FULL UESM针对六个确定性合成故障装置和另一个缺失证据案例产生了预设的保护性结果；靶向消融分析分离出了来源信息和失败传播的作用。在另一组KRAS G12D–GDP实验反馈系列中，环肽类似物的合成和SPR/BLI测试指导了位置2碱性侧链的选择以及双碱性基团的布置，使报告的SPR亲和力从CRO-748的约60 μM提高到748-R1的约6 μM和748-RK的约1 μM。使用31维Structured Capability and Evidence Grid（SCEG-31D）的比较表明，CP-GFM-SGX在多个方面相较其他设计平台具有一定优势。总之，我们评估了一种面向受体的拓扑感知生成式人工智能环肽设计工作流，并在KRAS反馈系列中展示了结合测量如何指导迭代化学优化。

items.title: AmyloCore-ML: AI/Machine Learning Enabled Identification of Amyloid Fibril Core Regions Using Protein Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Identification of amyloid forming regions in proteins remains central to understanding of their aggregation behaviour, which are central to various neurodegenerative and systemic disorders. Many predictors have been designed to identify amyloid forming regions, however they may not necessarily identify total residues found in actual disease associated fibril structures. To address this, we formed a sequence-based based predictor-AmyloCore-ML to ascertain structural amyloid-core propensity. The predictor was developed using experimentally determined fibril structures obtained from Amyloid Atlas. Ordered residues in the experimental structures were designated as core, and unresolved sampled from the same proteins as matched controls as non-core. Core and non-core regions were encoded using various physicochemical descriptors and protein language model (PLM) embeddings (ESM-2, ANKH, ProtT5) and evaluated using protein-grouped cross-validation. PLMs consistently outperformed physicochemical descriptors, with the best models reaching AUROC values of ~0.88 and AUPRC values of ~0.85. Locked full-length protein scans further localized experimental cores, with ESM-2/ExtraTrees achieving AUROC 0.833, AUPRC 0.751, and a mean peak distance of 12.4 residues. In comparative benchmarking, our predictor showed better performance metrics than CrossBeta and AggrescanAI. The framework therefore provides residue-resolved prediction of structurally incorporated amyloid-core regions directly from sequence.

items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型在蛋白分组交叉验证和全长扫描中取得AUROC约0.88、AUPRC约0.85，并优于CrossBeta和AggrescanAI，为神经退行性疾病相关淀粉样核心定位提供残基级工具。预测依赖已有实验纤维结构，外推到未解析或不同条件下的聚集体系仍需验证。
items.abstract_zh: 识别蛋白质中的淀粉样形成区域对于理解其聚集行为仍然至关重要，而聚集行为又与多种神经退行性和全身性疾病有关。已有许多预测器用于识别淀粉样形成区域，但它们未必能够识别实际疾病相关纤维结构中包含的全部残基。为此，我们构建了一个基于序列的预测器AmyloCore-ML，用于确定结构性淀粉样核心倾向性。该预测器使用从Amyloid Atlas获得的实验测定纤维结构开发。实验结构中的有序残基被定义为核心，并从相同蛋白中抽取未解析残基作为匹配的非核心对照。核心和非核心区域用多种物理化学描述符以及蛋白语言模型（PLM）嵌入（ESM-2、ANKH、ProtT5）编码，并通过蛋白质分组交叉验证进行评估。PLM始终优于物理化学描述符，最佳模型达到约0.88的AUROC和约0.85的AUPRC。锁定的全长蛋白扫描进一步定位了实验核心，其中ESM-2/ExtraTrees达到0.833的AUROC、0.751的AUPRC，平均峰值距离为12.4个残基。在比较基准测试中，我们的预测器在性能指标上优于CrossBeta和AggrescanAI。因此，该框架能够直接从序列提供结构性整合淀粉样核心区域的残基分辨率预测。

items.title: Building the Data Foundations for the Design and Discovery of Transition Metal Complexes
items.abstract_or_text: The unique chemistry of transition metal complexes (TMCs) enables several advanced technologies in diverse fields including renewable energies, medicine, and catalysis. Machine learning methods can accelerate their rational design but are bounded by limited dataset sizes, restricted chemical scopes, and insufficient quality. This Perspective surveys the current landscape of TMC datasets and investigates how they seek to address these challenges. The analysis focuses on the data curation processes as well as the scope of the properties provided, and their level of theory. Furthermore, the applications and methodological advancements enabled by TMC datasets are reviewed, including the generative design of metal ligands and the evolutionary optimization of TMCs. The Perspective concludes by outlining future directions, with particular emphasis on extending data to broader chemical scopes including non-equilibrium geometries, establishing community-wide data formats and benchmarks, and developing strategies to effectively integrate heterogeneous data sources.
items.summary_zh: 综述过渡金属配合物数据集的范围、性质、理论水平和整理流程，讨论其对配体生成设计和配合物进化优化的支持，并提出数据格式与基准发展方向。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 指出过渡金属配合物机器学习受数据规模、化学范围和质量限制，强调非平衡几何、统一格式和异构数据融合等基础设施问题，对催化与能源材料的可计算设计具有方法学价值。该文为Perspective，主要是现状分析和展望，不提供新的模型或实验性能。
items.abstract_zh: 过渡金属配合物（TMC）的独特化学性质支持可再生能源、医学和催化等多个领域的先进技术。机器学习方法可以加速其理性设计，但受到数据集规模有限、化学范围受限和质量不足的约束。本Perspective综述了当前TMC数据集的状况，并研究这些数据集如何应对上述挑战。分析重点包括数据整理流程、所提供性质的范围以及理论水平。此外，我们还综述了TMC数据集推动的应用和方法学进展，包括金属配体的生成式设计和TMC的进化优化。最后，Perspective提出未来方向，重点是将数据扩展到更广的化学范围（包括非平衡几何），建立社区通用的数据格式和基准，并发展有效整合异构数据源的策略。

items.title: Unleashing AI for preclinical drug development
items.abstract_or_text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping preclinical drug development across target discovery, therapeutic design, synthesis, functional characterization and safety assessment. In this review, we present an integrated view of AI across the preclinical pipeline, beginning with target identification, modality selection and representation learning for molecular, protein, structural, cellular and multimodal data. We then examine major generative modeling paradigms including autoregressive, latent-variable, diffusion, flow-based and guided approaches and their applications across small molecules, peptides, enzymes, antibodies, Tcell receptors and mRNA therapeutics. We discuss how these methods support de novo design, structure- and pocket-conditioned generation, sequence–structure co-design, affinity and activity optimization, developability engineering and synthesis-aware discovery. We further review AI-enabled retrosynthesis, reaction prediction and closed-loop experimental optimization, emphasizing the distinction between computational synthesizability and experimentally executable chemistry. Beyond molecular generation, we organize functional prediction from binding and kinetics through target engagement, pharmacological activity, mechanism of action, pathway response and phenotypic outcome. We also examine singlecell perturbation modeling, organoid-based drug-response prediction, toxicity and off-target assessment, and prospective validation across therapeutic modalities. Across these areas, we highlight the importance of uncertainty estimation, out-of-distribution generalization, reproducibility and experimentally grounded benchmarking. Finally, we discuss how integrating generative AI, mechanistic biology and iterative design–make–test–analyze cycles could transform AI from isolated predictive tools into decision-support systems for preclinical drug development.

items.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）正在重塑临床前药物开发，涵盖靶点发现、治疗设计、合成、功能表征和安全性评估。在本综述中，我们对AI在临床前流程中的应用进行整合性梳理，从靶点识别、治疗形式选择以及分子、蛋白质、结构、细胞和多模态数据的表示学习开始。随后，我们考察主要的生成建模范式，包括autoregressive、latent-variable、diffusion、flow-based和guided方法，以及它们在小分子、肽、酶、抗体、Tcell receptors和mRNA therapeutics中的应用。我们讨论这些方法如何支持de novo设计、结构和口袋条件生成、sequence–structure协同设计、亲和力和活性优化、可开发性工程以及合成感知发现。我们进一步综述AI支持的逆合成、反应预测和闭环实验优化，强调计算可合成性与实验上可执行的化学之间的区别。除分子生成之外，我们还组织了从结合和动力学到靶点占有、药理活性、作用机制、通路响应和表型结果的功能预测。我们也考察单细胞扰动建模、基于类器官的药物反应预测、毒性和脱靶评估，以及不同治疗形式的前瞻性验证。在这些领域中，我们强调不确定性估计、分布外泛化、可重复性和以实验为基础的基准测试的重要性。最后，我们讨论如何整合生成式AI、机制生物学和迭代式design–make–test–analyze循环，使AI从孤立的预测工具转变为临床前药物开发的决策支持系统。

items.title: AI-guided discovery for low-resource peptide engineering using evolutionary scale modeling
items.abstract_or_text: Data scarcity is a major bottleneck in artificial intelligence (AI)-guided peptide engineering, where experimental training sets often contain only tens to a few hundred sequences, and it is difficult to judge in advance whether a protein language model (PLM) will effectively guide iterative discovery before committing to wet-lab work. Here we present SCARSE, a machine learning framework that couples ESM2 protein language model embeddings with Gaussian process regression. Benchmarked across 24 diverse peptide and small-protein datasets spanning substitution and indel variants, antimicrobial peptides, and hemolytic peptides, SCARSE significantly outperformed hand-engineered descriptor baselines on substitution and indel tasks in low-data regimes (20-500 training samples) and performed comparably on short non-mutant peptides. In active learning simulations it consistently prioritized high-performing candidates, discovering up to 7-fold more top-tier peptides than random sampling. Cross-validation (CV) R2 correlated strongly with final active learning performance (Pearson r = 0.80-0.84), and evaluating on as few as 50 labeled peptides reduced CV R2 variance enough for it to serve as a practical, data-efficient criterion for assessing model suitability before iterative screening. SCARSE thus provides an early diagnostic indicator for active learning success and is freely available as an open-source Python package (pip) and through an interactive Hugging Face Spaces web interface.
items.summary_zh: 提出SCARSE，将ESM2蛋白语言模型嵌入与高斯过程回归结合，用于低数据肽工程，并以交叉验证R²预判主动学习是否适合迭代筛选。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在20–500个训练样本的多类肽和小蛋白数据集上优于手工描述符，主动学习模拟最多发现7倍的高性能肽，并给出仅需约50个标注肽的模型适用性诊断。主要限制是核心发现来自模拟和交叉验证，尚缺少前瞻性湿实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 数据稀缺是AI指导肽工程的主要瓶颈，因为实验训练集通常只有几十到几百条序列，而且在投入湿实验之前，很难预先判断蛋白语言模型（PLM）是否能有效指导迭代发现。在此，我们提出SCARSE，这是一种将ESM2蛋白语言模型嵌入与高斯过程回归结合的机器学习框架。我们在24个多样化的肽和小蛋白数据集上进行基准测试，这些数据集涵盖替换和indel变体、抗菌肽以及溶血肽。在低数据场景（20–500个训练样本）中，SCARSE在替换和indel任务上显著优于手工设计的描述符基线；在短的非突变肽上，其表现相当。在主动学习模拟中，SCARSE持续优先选择高性能候选物，相比随机采样最多发现7倍的高水平肽。交叉验证（CV）R²与最终主动学习表现高度相关（Pearson r = 0.80–0.84）；在仅有50条带标签肽的情况下进行评估，就能将CV R²的方差降低到足以作为迭代筛选前评估模型适用性的实用、数据高效标准。因此，SCARSE提供了一个主动学习成功可能性的早期诊断指标，并以开源Python软件包（pip）和交互式Hugging Face Spaces网页界面的形式免费提供。

items.title: Understanding when and how knowledge graphs add value to EHR-based clinical prediction across Parkinson's disease, multiple sclerosis, and chronic pain
items.abstract_or_text: Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) have emerged as a promising approach for incorporating biological knowledge into machine-learning models trained on electronic health record (EHR) data. However, their large scale and heterogeneous structure impose substantial computational cost, and it remains unclear whether their benefits generalize across diseases or depend on how the graph is constructed. We systematically evaluated KG integration across three diseases spanning distinct biological and clinical characteristics: multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, and chronic pain. For each disease we compared five modelling strategies, spanning EHR-only features and graph diffusion over concept-level, cohort-derived, disease-anchored, and full SPOKE (Scalable Precision Medicine Open Knowledge Engine) subgraphs, asking whether graph construction affects predictive performance and computational cost, whether KG integration improves classification over EHR-only models, and what the graph does to model behavior. Cohort-derived subgraphs, comprising roughly 45% of SPOKE's nodes and one-fifth of its edges, matched or modestly exceeded the full graph's performance while substantially reducing computational cost in all three diseases. The predictive benefit of KG integration, however, was strongly disease-dependent: it improved classification in Parkinson's disease, had no measurable effect in multiple sclerosis, and reduced performance in chronic pain. These differences were not explained by the amount of biological information incorporated: the disease with the largest shift toward molecular features showed no improvement, the sole beneficiary showed only a modest shift, and the disease with no molecular shift was penalized. Mechanistically, graph diffusion redistributed each disease's existing signal across many correlated features rather than adding independent biological signal, so that any gain depended on whether it added information beyond the EHR. These findings show that cohort-derived subgraphs offer a computationally efficient alternative to full-scale knowledge graphs, and that KG integration functions less as a universal accuracy booster than as a data- and disease-dependent transformation of the patient representation.
items.summary_zh: 系统比较知识图谱与 EHR 预测在 Parkinson's disease、multiple sclerosis 和 chronic pain 中的作用，发现队列衍生子图可降低计算成本，但收益高度依赖疾病和数据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨三种疾病拆解了知识图谱究竟何时有用，并指出图扩散主要重分配已有 EHR 信号，而非普遍增加独立生物学信息。
items.abstract_zh: 生物医学知识图谱（KG）已成为将生物学知识纳入基于电子健康记录（EHR）数据训练的机器学习模型的一种有前景的方法。然而，知识图谱规模大且结构异质，会带来显著计算成本；其收益是否能跨疾病泛化，或是否取决于图的构建方式，仍不清楚。我们系统评估了在三种具有不同生物学和临床特征的疾病中整合 KG 的效果：multiple sclerosis、Parkinson's disease 和 chronic pain。对于每种疾病，我们比较了五种建模策略，包括仅使用 EHR 特征，以及在概念级、队列衍生、疾病锚定和完整 SPOKE（Scalable Precision Medicine Open Knowledge Engine）子图上进行图扩散的策略，考察图构建如何影响预测性能和计算成本、KG 整合是否能超过仅使用 EHR 的模型，以及图对模型行为的影响。队列衍生子图约包含 SPOKE 节点的 45% 和边的五分之一；在三种疾病中，其性能与完整图相当或略高，同时显著降低了计算成本。然而，KG 整合的预测收益强烈依赖疾病：它提高了 Parkinson's disease 的分类性能，在 multiple sclerosis 中没有可测量的影响，并降低了 chronic pain 中的性能。这些差异不能由纳入的生物学信息量解释：分子特征转移幅度最大的疾病没有改善，唯一受益的疾病只有适度转移，而没有分子特征转移的疾病反而受到惩罚。从机制上看，图扩散将每种疾病已有的信号重新分配到许多相关特征中，而不是增加独立的生物学信号；因此，任何收益都取决于它是否向 EHR 之外增加了信息。这些结果表明，队列衍生子图是完整规模知识图谱的一种计算高效替代方案，而 KG 整合与其说是普遍的准确率提升器，不如说是对患者表示的一种依赖数据和疾病的变换。

items.title: Linking somatic variants to altered methylation profiles in nanopore-derived breast and pancreatic cancer genomes using unduliner
items.abstract_or_text: Research shows that genetic variation directly influences DNA methylation, and this association has generally been explored on germline SNPs and at a population level. The presence of genomic variation and base modification on sequence reads generated from a technology like nanopore sequencing offers an opportunity to link disease-specific variants to methylation changes in individual genomes. Here, we present unduliner, a framework with an embedded pretrained convolutional neural network model, that predicts somatic variants, single-nucleotide (SNVs) and structural (SVs), associated with methylation pattern changes in cancer genomes. We trained the model (accuracy = 0.803 on validation; 0.897 on held-out test) using phased sequence reads, single-nucleotide germline variants, per-base methylation probability, and variant proximity or presence in haplotype-specific differentially methylated regions (DMRs). Unduliner was applied to subline-specific variants from MCF7 breast cancer cell lines as proof-of-concept, and we demonstrated its ability to identify variant-stratified methylation differences independent of haplotype-based methylation differences. In a pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) sample, we identified coding and non-coding SNVs and SVs associated with tumour-normal DMRs, allele-specific methylation, and intratumour DMRs. These observations demonstrate that integrating long-read methylation and variant information can provide additional interpretative context for both coding and non-coding genomic variation beyond the conventional variant impact prediction tools. The results from unduliner include variant information, size and direction of methylation change with respect to the variant (increase or decrease), and genomic location of methylation change. Unduliner is publicly available on GitHub at https://github.com/Chisomgold/unduliner.
items.summary_zh: unduliner 将 nanopore 长读长测序中的体细胞 SNV、SV 和甲基化概率联合建模，在 MCF7 和 PDAC 样本中关联变异与差异甲基化区域。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把单个癌症基因组中的序列变异与甲基化变化放在同一长读长框架中解释，并公开 GitHub 实现；目前主要是验证集、细胞系和单个 PDAC 样本证据。
items.abstract_zh: 研究表明，遗传变异会直接影响 DNA 甲基化；过去这种关联通常围绕生殖系 SNP 并在群体层面进行探索。由 nanopore 测序等技术产生的序列读段，同时包含基因组变异和碱基修饰信息，为在单个基因组中将疾病特异性变异与甲基化变化联系起来提供了机会。在此，我们提出 unduliner，这是一种内置预训练卷积神经网络模型的框架，用于预测与癌症基因组甲基化模式变化相关的体细胞变异，包括单核苷酸变异（SNV）和结构变异（SV）。我们使用分相序列读段、单核苷酸生殖系变异、逐碱基甲基化概率，以及变异与单倍型特异性差异甲基化区域（DMR）的邻近关系或存在情况训练模型；模型在验证集上的准确率为 0.803，在留出测试集上的准确率为 0.897。我们将 unduliner 应用于 MCF7 乳腺癌细胞系的亚系特异性变异作为概念验证，结果显示它能够识别按变异分层的甲基化差异，并将其与基于单倍型的甲基化差异区分开来。在一份胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）样本中，我们识别出与肿瘤—正常 DMR、等位基因特异性甲基化和肿瘤内 DMR 相关的编码和非编码 SNV 及 SV。这些观察表明，整合长读长甲基化与变异信息，可以在传统变异影响预测工具之外，为编码和非编码基因组变异提供额外的解释背景。unduliner 的结果包括变异信息、相对于该变异的甲基化变化幅度和方向（增加或减少），以及甲基化变化发生的基因组位置。unduliner 已在 GitHub 公开，网址为 https://github.com/Chisomgold/unduliner。

items.title: AMMPER-2: A spatially explicit agent-based model of microbial radiobiology with redox dye simulation
items.abstract_or_text: To reduce health risks for human space exploration, it is important to model the effects of deep-space radiation on biological systems. The budding yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae is a common model organism in space radiobiology, but little is known about how radiation damage to individual cells translates into the population-level effects that experiments measure. The Agent-Based Model for Microbial Populations Exposed to Radiation (AMMPER) is a spatially explicit agent-based model that simulates the effects of ionizing radiation on S. cerevisiae cells and produces population-level results. Its goal is to improve experiment design and data interpretation. AMMPER-1 demonstrated that agent-based simulations can qualitatively reproduce the effects of proton radiation on the growth rate of wild-type and DNA-repair mutant yeast. Here, we present AMMPER-2, which addresses limitations of the first model and expands its capabilities. AMMPER-2 incorporates the dynamics of the redox dye alamarBlue, a data type commonly generated in spaceflight microbiology experiments, and models the fate of reactive oxygen species in more detail. It also adds an improved graphical interface and runs faster. AMMPER-2 remains easy to execute in Python on a standard personal laptop, providing space biologists a tool to explore experimental conditions, generate hypotheses, and interpret data from microbial space radiation experiments.

items.abstract_zh: 为了降低人类空间探索的健康风险，模拟深空辐射对生物系统的影响十分重要。出芽酵母 Saccharomyces cerevisiae 是空间辐射生物学中常用的模式生物，但人们对单个细胞的辐射损伤如何转化为实验测量的群体层面效应知之甚少。面向暴露于辐射的微生物群体代理模型（Agent-Based Model for Microbial Populations Exposed to Radiation，AMMPER）是一种空间显式代理模型，用于模拟电离辐射对 S. cerevisiae 细胞的影响并产生群体层面结果，其目标是改进实验设计和数据解释。AMMPER-1 已显示，代理模型模拟可以定性再现质子辐射对野生型和 DNA 修复突变酵母生长速率的影响。在此，我们提出 AMMPER-2，解决第一代模型的局限并扩展其功能。AMMPER-2 纳入了氧化还原染料 alamarBlue 的动力学，这是空间飞行微生物学实验中常见的一类数据；同时更详细地模拟活性氧的命运。它还增加了改进的图形界面并提高了运行速度。AMMPER-2 仍可在标准个人笔记本电脑上通过 Python 轻松运行，为空间生物学家探索实验条件、提出假设和解释微生物空间辐射实验数据提供工具。

items.abstract_or_text: ReplaySSM now runs in production in GLM-5.3-Flash and Kimi-K3, and ships in TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, FlashInfer, and SGLang! It speeds up standard decoding (up to 1.47x) and speculative decoding (up to 2.1x), and now also enables a low-precision SSM state whose rounding error never propagates through the recurrence. Building on our earlier ReplaySSM work, we collaborated with @NVIDIA to pin down what the method really unlocks. Caching SSM inputs instead of the state is what ReplaySSM does. What it changes is that computing the output and updating the state can be separated during decoding. All three gains follow from that separation. Joint blog post, paper, and code with @NVIDIA and @tri_dao 👇

items.title: Modular Cell-Free Extract Mixing Enables Soluble, Active Biomanufacturing of Difficult-to-Express and Aggregation-Prone Proteins
items.abstract_or_text: Cell-free protein synthesis (CFPS) is a powerful platform for rapid protein prototyping and biomanufacturing, but expression of complex proteins remains limited by labor-intensive extract preparation as well as the inability of conventional Escherichia coli extracts to efficiently support disulfide bond formation and prevent protein aggregation. We previously developed a Cell-Free Autoinduction (CFAI) workflow that simplifies extract preparation, however, CFAI-derived extracts retain the folding limitations of standard E. coli systems for producing traditionally difficult proteins. Here, we address these challenges by utilizing extracts enriched with molecular chaperones or Erv1p-based oxidative folding catalysts and combining them through a modular extract mixing strategy to enable independent tuning of the cell-free folding environment. This workflow supplies folding factors through enriched extracts, avoiding recurring purchases of purified supplements and enabling a modeled reagent-cost advantage. To evaluate real-world applications and utility of lysate mixing for protein production, we demonstrate a 10-fold increase in solubility of the aggregation-prone bacterial toxin Colicin M, achieving >95% soluble protein while retaining antimicrobial activity. We further used a Design of Experiments (DoE) framework to optimize combinations of chaperone-enriched and Erv1p-based oxidative folding extracts containing either protein disulfide isomerase (PDI) or DsbC. The optimized compositions produced >95% soluble truncated human tissue plasminogen activator (vtPA), comprising the kringle 2 and protease domains, while preserving enzymatic activity. Together, these results demonstrate that CFAI-derived modular extract mixing provides a tunable, high-throughput strategy with low modeled materials costs for tailoring cell-free biochemical environments for difficult-to-express proteins, expanding CFPS utility for protein engineering and biomanufacturing.
items.summary_zh: 通过模块化混合富含分子伴侣或Erv1p氧化折叠催化剂的无细胞提取物，改善难表达和易聚集蛋白的可溶性、活性和规模化生产。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法在Colicin M和截短人组织型纤溶酶原激活剂（vtPA）中均实现超过95%的可溶蛋白，并保留抗菌或酶活性，显示出CFPS工艺调控价值。摘要没有明确的AI建模成分，材料成本优势也是模型估算，因此其AI×Chem相关性和经济性仍需谨慎解读。
items.abstract_zh: 无细胞蛋白合成（CFPS）是快速蛋白原型开发和生物制造的强大平台，但复杂蛋白的表达仍受到提取物制备劳动密集，以及常规Escherichia coli提取物难以有效支持二硫键形成和防止蛋白聚集的限制。我们此前开发了Cell-Free Autoinduction（CFAI）工作流以简化提取物制备；然而，CFAI衍生提取物在生产传统上难以表达的蛋白时仍保留标准Escherichia coli体系的折叠局限。在此，我们使用富含分子伴侣或基于Erv1p的氧化折叠催化剂的提取物，并通过模块化提取物混合策略将它们组合，从而能够独立调节无细胞折叠环境。该工作流通过富集提取物提供折叠因子，避免反复购买纯化补充剂，并带来模型估算的试剂成本优势。为评估裂解液混合用于蛋白生产的实际应用和效用，我们展示了聚集倾向性细菌毒素Colicin M的可溶性提高10倍，在保留抗菌活性的同时达到超过95%的可溶蛋白。我们还使用实验设计（DoE）框架，优化富含分子伴侣的提取物与基于Erv1p的氧化折叠提取物的组合，其中后者含有蛋白质二硫键异构酶（PDI）或DsbC。优化后的配方使截短的人组织型纤溶酶原激活剂（vtPA）（包含kringle 2和protease结构域）达到超过95%的可溶蛋白，同时保留酶活性。总体而言，这些结果表明，CFAI衍生的模块化提取物混合提供了一种可调、高通量且材料成本模型较低的策略，可为难表达蛋白定制无细胞生化环境，扩大CFPS在蛋白工程和生物制造中的应用。
items.author_line: Firmansyah, L., Delmundo, A., Oza, J. P.

items.title: Beyond the Final Layer: Evaluating Single-Cell Foundation Model Representations for Molecular Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell foundation models (scFMs) are commonly benchmarked using final-layer embeddings, although useful depth may depend on the task. We evaluate Geneformer, scBERT, scGPT, and scFoundation as frozen feature extractors for cell-type and perturbation-response prediction using layer-wise probes, leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) selection, readout controls, representation diagnostics, centered kernel alignment (CKA), and retrieval/collapse analyses. Intermediate layers significantly improve cell-type accuracy for scGPT and scBERT in several settings, while Geneformer and scFoundation generally show performance comparable to their final layers. For perturbation prediction, LODO identifies layer 1 as an earliest-on-par candidate across all four models, without establishing universal superiority. Paired scGPT CLS and mean-pooling analyses show that readout affects preferred depth. CKA and representation metrics reveal model- and task-dependent geometric changes, while retrieval and collapse checks support the robustness of perturbation findings. We recommend reporting extraction depth, readout, selection protocol, and task-specific diagnostics. A validated non-final layer may also reduce computation, although efficiency was not directly benchmarked.
items.summary_zh: 系统评估Geneformer、scBERT、scGPT和scFoundation的层级表示，发现中间层在部分细胞类型和扰动响应预测任务中优于最终层，并提出规范化报告协议。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 指出单细胞基础模型的特征提取深度会影响下游结果，LODO选择、readout对照、CKA和塌缩分析增强了评估严谨性。效率收益尚未直接基准测试，也未证明存在对所有模型和任务都最优的统一层。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞基础模型（scFMs）通常使用最终层嵌入进行基准测试，但有用的网络深度可能取决于任务。我们将Geneformer、scBERT、scGPT和scFoundation作为冻结特征提取器进行评估，用于细胞类型和扰动响应预测，并采用逐层探针、留一数据集外（LODO）选择、readout对照、表示诊断、中心化核对齐（CKA）以及检索/塌缩分析。中间层显著提高了scGPT和scBERT在若干设置下的细胞类型准确率，而Geneformer和scFoundation的表现通常与最终层相当。对于扰动预测，LODO在全部四个模型中都将第1层识别为最早达到同等水平的候选层，但并未证明其具有普遍优势。成对比较scGPT的CLS和mean-pooling表明，readout会影响偏好的深度。CKA和表示指标揭示了依赖模型和任务的几何变化，而检索和塌缩检查支持扰动结果的稳健性。我们建议报告特征提取深度、readout、选择协议和任务特异性诊断。经过验证的非最终层还可能降低计算量，但本文没有直接对效率进行基准测试。
items.author_line: Wen, M.-C. C., Lyu, Y., Robbins, A.

items.title: Probing Physical Intuition in Large Language Models through Partner-Dependent Mutation Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Structure-guided mutation design requires relating a proposed substitution to its molecular environment to anticipate its effects. Existing evaluations of large language models (LLMs) in protein engineering emphasize sequence-based prediction or tool-integrated workflows, leaving unclear whether LLMs themselves can infer mutation effects from structural evidence without dedicated predictors. We evaluate physical intuition-qualitative reasoning that connects structural observations with molecular interaction principles-using a benchmark that tests the same substitution in the same protein across different binding partners, with predictions based on local atomic coordinates and no dedicated mutation-effect predictors. In the tested comparisons, the best-performing LLM achieved group accuracy comparable to the evaluated energy predictors and Biomni, an LLM-driven tool workflow, while the methods differed in their prediction patterns. Most evaluated LLMs achieved higher group accuracy for larger affinity improvements. Structural interventions support selective dependence on mutation-site and partner information, while assessable structural claims largely agree with the supplied coordinates. These findings support direct LLM structural reasoning as a basis for developing rational mutation-design tools that connect molecular observations with partner-specific effects.
items.summary_zh: 用配对结合伙伴的突变预测基准测试大型语言模型是否能从局部原子坐标和分子相互作用原则推断伙伴依赖的突变效应。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把LLM的结构推理与能量预测器和Biomni工作流进行对照，结果显示最佳LLM在组准确率上相当，并能选择性利用突变位点和伙伴信息。研究规模和比较方法有限，且“物理直觉”仍是间接测量，不能替代定量亲和力实验。
items.abstract_zh: 结构指导的突变设计要求将提出的替换与其分子环境联系起来，以预期其影响。现有对大型语言模型（LLM）在蛋白工程中能力的评估强调基于序列的预测或集成工具的工作流，因此尚不清楚LLM自身能否在没有专用预测器的情况下，从结构证据推断突变效应。我们使用一个基准测试来评估这种连接结构观察与分子相互作用原理的物理直觉式定性推理：在该测试中，同一蛋白中的同一替换被置于不同结合伙伴环境中，模型仅依据局部原子坐标进行预测，不使用专用突变效应预测器。在所测试的比较中，表现最佳的LLM达到了与所评估能量预测器和Biomni（一个由LLM驱动的工具工作流）相当的组准确率，但不同方法的预测模式不同。大多数被评估的LLM在亲和力改善幅度较大的组中取得了更高的组准确率。结构干预支持模型选择性依赖突变位点和伙伴信息，而可评估的结构陈述大体上与所提供的坐标一致。这些发现支持将LLM直接结构推理作为开发理性突变设计工具的基础，使分子观察能够与依赖伙伴的效应相联系。
items.author_line: Cheng, L., Zheng, K., Huang, W., Chen, H.-F., Yu, Z.

items.title: Reformulating Protein Corona Prediction as Universal Protein-conditioned Learning
items.abstract_or_text: When nanoparticles enter biological environments, their surfaces are rapidly coated by proteins, forming a protein corona that governs their biological identity and downstream responses. Existing computational methods treat each protein as an independent prediction task, preventing the learning of shared adsorption principles and limiting generalization beyond experimentally characterized proteins. Here we introduce NanoPCT, a universal protein-conditioned learning framework that jointly models nanoparticle physicochemical properties and protein sequence representations. Using frozen ESM-2 embeddings and a joint interaction transformer, NanoPCT learns transferable representations of nano-bio interaction patterns across hundreds of proteins and maintains robust performance as protein diversity increases. The learned protein representation further enables zero-shot prediction for previously unseen proteins and biologically distinct protein groups through classifier reconstruction in embedding space. Beyond prediction, NanoPCT supports large-scale in silico inverse design and reveals consistent adsorption preferences between observed and unseen protein populations, suggesting that it captures transferable interaction patterns rather than protein-specific memorization. NanoPCT provides a unified framework for protein corona prediction, zero-shot generalization, and rational nanomaterial design.
items.summary_zh: 提出NanoPCT，将纳米颗粒物化性质与蛋白序列表示联合建模，用于蛋白冠预测、未见蛋白零样本泛化和纳米材料逆向设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把每个蛋白独立建模改为蛋白条件化的统一学习，并报告在蛋白多样性增加时仍保持性能及对未见蛋白的零样本预测能力，为纳米-生物界面设计提供可迁移表示。摘要未给出实验设计规模和具体误差指标，逆向设计结果主要是in silico推断。
items.abstract_zh: 当纳米颗粒进入生物环境时，其表面会迅速被蛋白质包覆，形成蛋白冠；蛋白冠决定纳米颗粒的生物学身份及后续响应。现有计算方法将每种蛋白视为独立的预测任务，阻碍了共享吸附规律的学习，并限制了对实验表征之外蛋白的泛化。在此，我们提出NanoPCT，这是一种通用的蛋白条件化学习框架，将纳米颗粒物化性质与蛋白序列表示联合建模。NanoPCT使用冻结的ESM-2嵌入和联合交互Transformer，在数百种蛋白之间学习可迁移的纳米-生物相互作用模式，并在蛋白多样性增加时保持稳健性能。学习到的蛋白表示还通过在嵌入空间中重建分类器，实现了对未见蛋白和生物学上不同蛋白群的零样本预测。除预测之外，NanoPCT支持大规模in silico逆向设计，并揭示了观测到的蛋白群体与未见蛋白群体之间一致的吸附偏好，提示模型捕获的是可迁移的相互作用模式，而不是针对特定蛋白的记忆。NanoPCT为蛋白冠预测、零样本泛化和理性纳米材料设计提供了统一框架。
items.author_line: Wu, X., Wang, C., Jin, Y., Zhao, Y., Tang, H.

items.title: Drug Molecular and Route Similarity-Aware Retrieval-Augmented LLM Generation with Knowledge Graph for Semantic Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: To address the inherent limitations of large language models (LLMs) in chemical synthesis—hallucinations, and low knowledge dense—this study presents a Knowledge Graph–enhanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework (KG-RAG-LLM) with a multi-scale calculation of molecular and route similarity. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that KG-RAG-LLM significantly mitigates hallucinations, increasing the proportion of concrete chemical information in generated responses to 39.52%–40.87%, drastically outperforming baseline LLMs and standard literature-based RAG pipelines in response completeness and accuracy. To overcome the inability of traditional 2D linear fingerprints to capture 3D spatial properties and reaction path variations, we further developed a multidimensional molecular and route similarity calculation combining SimHash, core similarity, and FCFP, as an alternative to Route CGR representations coupled with UMAP dimensionality reduction. This formulation accurately distinguishes between subtle and distinct synthetic strategies, demonstrating superior precision over traditional clustering methods for fuzzy retrieval of synthetic routes. Overall, this work provides a reliable, knowledge-dense solution for intelligent retrosynthetic Semantic Reasoning.
items.summary_zh: 提出KG-RAG-LLM，将知识图谱、分子与合成路线多尺度相似性计算和检索增强生成结合，用于更可靠的逆合成语义推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 报告生成回答中具体化学信息比例达到39.52%–40.87%，并声称优于基线LLM和文献RAG；SimHash、core similarity和FCFP有助于区分细微但不同的合成策略。摘要仅给出经验评估，未说明实验合成验证、数据划分和评价定义，不能据此确认实际路线可执行性。
items.abstract_zh: 为解决大型语言模型（LLM）在化学合成中的固有局限——幻觉和知识密度低——本研究提出一种知识图谱增强的检索增强生成框架（KG-RAG-LLM），并结合分子和路线相似性的多尺度计算。经验评估显示，KG-RAG-LLM显著减轻了幻觉，使生成回答中具体化学信息的比例提高到39.52%–40.87%，在回答完整性和准确性方面大幅超过基线LLM和标准的基于文献的RAG流程。为克服传统二维线性指纹无法捕捉三维空间性质和反应路径变化的问题，我们进一步开发了多维分子与路线相似性计算，将SimHash、core similarity和FCFP结合起来，作为Route CGR表示与UMAP降维组合方案的替代方法。该形式能够准确区分细微和明显不同的合成策略，在模糊合成路线检索中显示出优于传统聚类方法的精度。总体而言，这项工作为智能逆合成语义推理提供了一种可靠、知识密集的解决方案。
items.author_line: Jiaxin Lao, Liansuo Zu

items.title: Coordinated Enhancement of Molecular and Spatial Fidelity for Biological Inference in Spatial Transcriptomics
items.abstract_or_text: Understanding tissue organization requires accurate molecular quantification and faithful spatial localization. Spatial omics, particularly spatial transcriptomics (ST), face measurement trade-offs that limit simultaneous achievement of molecular and spatial fidelity across spatial resolution, detection sensitivity, molecular-tissue alignment and cell-level fidelity. Existing computational methods typically target individual aspects and optimize them in isolation, despite their interdependence. Here we present FOCUS, a multimodal generative foundation model for coordinated ST enhancement. FOCUS integrates native ST with histology images, cell masks, scRNA-seq references and spatial co-expression priors through task-specific modules, with cross-task coordination enabling joint correction of co-occurring limitations. FOCUS improved the performance of individual enhancement tasks and provided additional gains with coordinated mitigation of coupled limitations. Across immunology, tissue development and oncology, FOCUS recovered biologically consistent patterns obscured in native ST or isolated enhancement, enabling clearer inference of neutrophil-tumor interactions, spatial osteocyte differentiation and primary-metastatic HNSCC programs. Together, FOCUS establishes coordinated enhancement of molecular and spatial fidelity as a strategy for downstream biological inference from ST.
items.summary_zh: FOCUS 是融合空间转录组、组织学、细胞掩膜、scRNA-seq 参考和空间共表达先验的多模态生成基础模型，用于协同提升空间转录组的分子定量和空间定位保真度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时处理空间组学中的多种测量权衡，并在免疫、组织发育和肿瘤场景中恢复生物学模式；摘要未提供具体样本量和独立实验验证细节。
items.abstract_zh: 理解组织组织结构需要准确的分子定量和可信的空间定位。空间组学，尤其是空间转录组（ST），面临多种测量权衡，限制了在空间分辨率、检测灵敏度、分子—组织对齐和细胞层面保真度之间同时取得理想表现。现有计算方法通常只针对单个方面，并将相互依赖的因素分开优化。在此，我们提出 FOCUS，一种用于协同增强 ST 的多模态生成基础模型。FOCUS 通过任务特异性模块整合原生 ST、组织学图像、细胞掩膜、scRNA-seq 参考和空间共表达先验，并通过跨任务协同联合校正同时出现的多种限制。FOCUS 提升了单项增强任务的性能；在协同缓解相互耦合的限制时，还可获得额外收益。在免疫学、组织发育和肿瘤学场景中，FOCUS 恢复了在原生 ST 或孤立增强结果中被遮蔽、但在生物学上保持一致的模式，从而更清晰地推断中性粒细胞—肿瘤相互作用、空间性骨细胞分化和原发—转移性 HNSCC 程序。总之，协同增强分子和空间保真度可作为从 ST 开展下游生物学推断的一种策略。
items.author_line: Wang, X., Que, N., Liu, H., Tao, C., Jiang, Y., Jiang, Y., Zhu, P., Xu, J., Yan, H., Ye, B., Price, S., Xi, J., Wang, X., Li, C.

items.title: Representing biological concepts as directions in foundation model embeddings
items.abstract_or_text: Biological foundation models encode rich information about protein structure, function, and cellular state in high-dimensional embeddings, but accessing specific biological properties typically relies on additional, task-specific prediction models. Here, we show that diverse biological properties can be mapped to interpretable, reusable directions in embedding space. In the Concept Activation Vector (CAV) approach, examples representing a concept are distinguished from a background set using a linear model, and the resulting weight vector defines the CAV for that concept. In protein embeddings, CAVs recover Gene Ontology and Enzyme Commission annotations, localize Pfam domains, reveal novel structural relationships, and capture DNA-binding and protein-interaction interface specificity. In single-cell embeddings, CAVs isolate cancer-associated expression transitions, and gene variation along these axes substantially agrees with conventional differential-expression analysis despite being a distinct computational approach. Together, these results establish concept directions as a common representation, enabling diverse biological features to be compared, localized, and manipulated.
items.summary_zh: 概念激活向量（CAV）把蛋白质和单细胞基础模型嵌入中的生物学属性表示为可解释、可复用的方向，并恢复 GO、EC、Pfam、DNA 结合和癌症表达转变等特征。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供跨蛋白质和单细胞表示的统一解释与操控方式；摘要主要展示关联和定位能力，未声称由这些方向产生生物学因果效应。
items.abstract_zh: 生物学基础模型在高维嵌入中编码了丰富的蛋白质结构、功能和细胞状态信息，但要访问特定生物学属性，通常仍需额外的任务特异性预测模型。在此，我们显示，多种生物学属性可以映射为嵌入空间中可解释、可复用的方向。在概念激活向量（CAV）方法中，使用线性模型将代表某一概念的样本与背景集合区分开来，所得权重向量定义了该概念的 CAV。在蛋白质嵌入中，CAV 可以恢复 Gene Ontology 和 Enzyme Commission 注释，定位 Pfam 结构域，揭示新的结构关系，并捕获 DNA 结合特异性和蛋白质相互作用界面特异性。在单细胞嵌入中，CAV 可以分离与癌症相关的表达转变；沿这些轴的基因变化与传统差异表达分析高度一致，尽管二者是不同的计算方法。总体而言，这些结果确立了概念方向作为一种通用表示，使不同生物学特征能够被比较、定位和操控。
items.author_line: Shamail, A., McWhite, C. D.

items.title: Benchmarking single-cell foundation models reveals an advantage in the low-data regime for cell-type and disease-state prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell foundation models perform well on cell-type classification, but their value for disease-state prediction and their advantage over classical representations remains unclear. We benchmarked cell-representations from four foundation models using logistic regression, on 868 disease-prediction tasks (82 datasets) and 65 cell-type datasets from CELLxGENE. With full data, the baseline (log-normalized counts) outperformed the best model (TranscriptFormer-Sapiens) for cell type and matched it for disease. However, with few labeled cells, TranscriptFormer-Sapiens significantly outperformed the baseline in both tasks up to ~102 samples per class. Our comprehensive zero-shot benchmark identifies the data-scarce regime as a domain where Single-cell foundation models truly show advantage.
items.summary_zh: 在 868 个疾病预测任务、82 个数据集和 65 个细胞类型数据集上比较四种单细胞基础模型，发现其优势主要出现在每类样本约 102 个以内的低数据场景。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模、跨数据集基准明确了单细胞基础模型的适用边界：全数据时传统 log-normalized counts 可胜出，标签稀缺时 TranscriptFormer-Sapiens 才显示稳定优势。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞基础模型在细胞类型分类上表现良好，但它们对疾病状态预测的价值以及相对于经典表示的优势仍不清楚。我们使用逻辑回归，对来自 CELLxGENE 的四种基础模型的细胞表示开展基准测试，覆盖 868 个疾病预测任务（82 个数据集）和 65 个细胞类型数据集。在使用完整数据时，基线方法（经对数归一化的计数）在细胞类型任务上优于最佳模型（TranscriptFormer-Sapiens），在疾病任务上与其相当。然而，当标注细胞较少时，TranscriptFormer-Sapiens 在两类任务中均显著优于基线，优势可持续到每类约 102 个样本。我们的综合零样本基准确定，数据稀缺场景是单细胞基础模型真正具有优势的领域。

items.abstract_or_text: Dusting off this tweet from April because this gap in shared understanding of LLM capability is *widening*. It's now less "two groups of people speaking past each other" and more a sharp funnel. - Napkin math somewhere around 6B people (~75% of the population) have barely come in contact with LLMs at all. - Around 1-2B (~20%) are casual and infrequent users of free-tier ChatGPT-like products. This group sees derpy chatbots and treats them a bit like a better Google search, a writing aid, or etc. Maybe an agent tries to book you a flight. I have non-tech friends who (reasonably, imo) say they have not much use for it at all. Even many professionals outside of math&code are in this tier. For example, execs and many other functions spend a lot of their time talking to other people, so while they understand what is happening intellectually, it is still second-hand and a bit abstract. - Now we get to professional use of frontier-grade LLMs in math&code. Somewhere around 20M people (0.2%) see first-hand that large, complex projects that used to take them weeks/months can now be completed by agents with a prompt. Building apps, copying apps, translating apps, decompiling apps from binaries... This has all happened very quickly and recently - less than 1 year ago, I was writing code manually by hand, typing memorized computer code commands into a code editor character by character, occasionally pressing Tab to autocomplete a little chunk of code. - And finally we get to the ~5,000 people (~0.00006%) with access to frontier-grade systems internally. The external world has seen the preview. It looks like swarms of thousands of agents collaborating over weeks on software mega projects: minting zero days, running cyber attacks and defenses at machine speeds, discovering new science, advancing the frontier of mathematics. Things that would have taken top professionals in the industry years of work. Meanwhile, human review and comprehension are starting to fall behind. For example, people are still involved in the "archeology" of the OpenAI-HF incident from many months ago. Mathematicians may be poring over the 722 manuscripts on frontier mathematics for a while. The funnel is driven by a combination of factors: 1. The impact scales with ambition, problem size, and horizon. A question with a paragraph answer barely stresses the system. You need a reservoir of big, difficult problems that you really care about. This aspect drives the consumer / professional dimension of the funnel. 2. The jaggedness of the system (which I have written about a lot separately). Capability peaks in domains that are digital, verifiable and economically valuable. This is because LLM capability emerges from reinforcement learning on verifiable rewards on a curated environment mixture driven by revenue potential. This aspect primarily drives the area (e.g. math&code) dimension of the funnel. 3. Access. Free-tier, paid-tier, internal. So this is the weirdness of the moment. The general public has mostly not interacted with these systems. When they have, it looks like a derpy chatbot. The majority of professionals still see only a modest uplift. And a small sliver of professionals are experiencing the vertigo of the curve going vertical. And it is all happening at the same time.

items.title: FMS2Lib: A Machine Learning-Ready Tandem Mass Spectral Library for Nontargeted Analysis of Non-conventional PFAS
items.abstract_or_text: Nontargeted identification of non-conventional per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), including fluorinated pharmaceuticals and pesticides, remains challenging. Existing machine learning models for nontargeted analysis, primarily trained on tandem mass spectra of nonfluorinated compounds, may not generalize well to non-conventional PFAS because of their distinct mass spectrometric chemistry. Here, we established FMS2Lib, an experimental tandem mass spectral library containing 34,686 fluorinated drug-like compounds (F 1-4 ), to support machine learning-based nontargeted PFAS analysis. We demonstrated that training with FMS2Lib substantially improved the performance of existing models for both molecular formula prediction and structure annotation. We further applied these models to identify PFAS in passive samplers from wastewater effluents and surface waters and in high-throughput laboratory biotransformation experiments, revealing dozens of non-conventional PFAS and their biotransformation products. Collectively, FMS2Lib addresses a major data bottleneck in machine learning-based nontargeted analysis of non-conventional PFAS.
items.summary_zh: 建立包含34,686种含氟类药物化合物串联质谱的FMS2Lib库，并将其用于非靶向PFAS的机器学习分子式预测和结构注释。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对非传统PFAS缺少训练数据这一瓶颈，数据集不仅提升模型性能，还在废水、地表水和生物转化实验中发现了数十种PFAS及其产物。局限在于摘要未给出具体性能增幅和外部验证细节，且应用对象集中于含氟化合物。
items.abstract_zh: 非靶向鉴定非传统全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS），包括含氟药物和农药，仍然具有挑战性。现有用于非靶向分析的机器学习模型主要用非氟化合物的串联质谱训练，因此可能无法很好地泛化到非传统PFAS，因为后者具有不同的质谱化学性质。在此，我们建立了FMS2Lib，这是一个实验串联质谱库，包含34,686种含氟类药物化合物（F 1-4），用于支持基于机器学习的非靶向PFAS分析。我们证明，使用FMS2Lib进行训练能够显著提升现有模型在分子式预测和结构注释两项任务上的性能。随后，我们将这些模型应用于废水出水和地表水中的被动采样器，以及高通量实验室生物转化实验，发现了数十种非传统PFAS及其生物转化产物。总体而言，FMS2Lib解决了基于机器学习的非靶向分析中非传统PFAS数据不足这一主要瓶颈。

items.title: From Vacuum Geometry to Solution-Phase Electronic Properties and Thermodynamics via Equivariant Neural Networks
items.abstract_or_text: We introduce a general framework for predicting solution-phase quantum-mechanical (QM) properties of drug-like molecules directly from gas-phase geometries, without solvent-specific structural optimization or property calculations. Using current equivariant neural network (ENN) architectures, such as MACE and Allegro, we demonstrate that they can also predict extensive and intensive QM properties in implicit water at a high level of theory. Direct-and ∆-learning strategies are employed for this prediction task using the Aquamarine dataset, which provides QM properties for the same molecules in both environments. The developed models are systematically evaluated for scalability to larger molecules, transferability across chemical space, and generalization to out-of-equilibrium configurations. Our results show that, despite substantial differences between gas-and solution-phase conformational ensembles, the models can accurately reconstruct ensemble-averaged solution-phase properties from gas-phase molecular dynamics. We further integrate the learned QM properties into the QUEDsol framework (“QUantum Electronic Descriptors in SOLution”) as electronic descriptors for hydration free-energy prediction. A simple and interpretable quadratic regression model trained on the FreeSolv dataset achieves state-of-the-art performance on the challenging and chemically diverse FlexiSol benchmark, outperforming previously reported QM-and ML-based approaches. These results establish ENNs as a versatile approach for inter-phase molecular property prediction and demonstrate that environment-specific QM descriptors generated from gas-phase geometries can provide transferable inputs for complex thermodynamic modeling.
items.summary_zh: 利用等变神经网络从气相几何直接预测药物样分子的溶液相量子力学性质，并将学习到的电子描述符用于水合自由能建模。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法避免逐分子进行溶剂特异性结构优化，在Aquamarine、FreeSolv和FlexiSol上检验了规模扩展、化学空间迁移和非平衡构象泛化，说明气相分子动力学可提供可迁移的溶液相输入。摘要未报告实验测量验证，性能依赖数据集和隐式水模型。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个通用框架，可直接从气相几何预测药物样分子的溶液相量子力学（QM）性质，而无需进行溶剂特异性结构优化或性质计算。使用当前的等变神经网络（ENN）架构，例如MACE和Allegro，我们证明这些模型也能在高理论水平下预测隐式水中的广延和强度型QM性质。我们使用提供相同分子在两种环境中QM性质的Aquamarine数据集，采用直接学习和Δ-learning策略完成这一预测任务。我们系统评估了所开发模型对更大分子的可扩展性、跨化学空间的迁移能力以及对非平衡构象的泛化能力。结果表明，尽管气相与溶液相构象系综存在显著差异，模型仍能从气相分子动力学准确重建系综平均的溶液相性质。我们进一步将学习到的QM性质整合到QUEDsol（“QUantum Electronic Descriptors in SOLution”）框架中，作为水合自由能预测的电子描述符。在FreeSolv数据集上训练的简单且可解释的二次回归模型，在具有挑战性且化学多样的FlexiSol基准上取得了state-of-the-art性能，超过此前报道的基于QM和ML的方法。这些结果确立了ENN作为相间分子性质预测的通用方法，并表明由气相几何生成的环境特异性QM描述符可以为复杂热力学建模提供可迁移输入。

items.title: Development of a Multimodal Large Language Model for Early Warning and Diagnosis of Dry Eye Disease
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background This study aimed to develop and externally validate an instruction-tuned multimodal large language model (MLLM) for early warning and early diagnosis of dry eye disease (DED) using routinely obtainable clinical data. Methods A total of 874 participants were enrolled, including an internal development cohort (n = 743) from Peking University Third Hospital (October 2024 to August 2025) and an independent external validation cohort (n = 131) from three additional centers. Participants included both DED and non-DED individuals, diagnosed according to the Chinese Expert Consensus (2020) and TFOS DEWS II criteria. We developed DED-MLLM on the basis of Qwen2-VL and constructed a domain-specific instruction-tuning dataset integrating Ocular Surface Disease Index (OSDI), Standard Patient Evaluation of Eye Dryness (SPEED), self-reported questionnaires, ophthalmic imaging, and clinical examination data. Model performance was evaluated for risk stratification and diagnosis under both diagnostic frameworks, with ablation analyses used to examine the relative contributions of visual and structured clinical modalities. Results Based on the international diagnostic criteria for DED, the model achieved an accuracy of 0.8232 for early warning (specificity: 0.6873, sensitivity: 0.9558) and an accuracy of 0.9203 for diagnosis (specificity: 0.8776, sensitivity: 0.9720). According to the Chinese diagnostic criteria for DED, the model achieved an accuracy of 0.9584 for early warning (specificity: 0.9112, sensitivity: 0.9927) and an accuracy of 0.9327 for diagnosis (specificity: 0.8742, sensitivity: 0.9851). External validation showed AUCs of 0.910 and 0.957 for early warning and 0.960 and 0.893 for diagnosis. Ablation analyses indicated that structured clinical information contributed most strongly to diagnostic performance, whereas image-based information provided complementary, interpretable ocular-surface evidence. Conclusion The proposed DED-MLLM demonstrates excellent performance in both early warning and diagnosis of DED.
items.summary_zh: 基于 Qwen2-VL 的多模态大语言模型 DED-MLLM，整合问卷、眼科影像和临床检查数据，在 874 名参与者及三个中心的外部队列上完成干眼病早期预警和诊断验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 有独立外部验证和消融分析，显示结构化临床信息贡献最大、影像提供互补证据；但仍是 preprint，不能替代临床诊断。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景：本研究旨在开发并外部验证一种经过指令调优的多模态大语言模型（MLLM），利用常规可获得的临床数据对干眼病（DED）进行早期预警和早期诊断。方法：共纳入 874 名参与者，包括来自北京大学第三医院的内部开发队列（n = 743，2024 年 10 月至 2025 年 8 月）和来自另外三个中心的独立外部验证队列（n = 131）。参与者包括 DED 患者和非 DED 个体，诊断依据为《中国专家共识（2020）》和 TFOS DEWS II 标准。我们以 Qwen2-VL 为基础开发 DED-MLLM，并构建领域特异性的指令调优数据集，整合眼表疾病指数（OSDI）、标准患者眼干评估（SPEED）、自报问卷、眼科影像和临床检查数据。在两套诊断框架下评估模型的风险分层和诊断性能，并通过消融分析考察视觉模态和结构化临床模态的相对贡献。结果：按照国际 DED 诊断标准，模型在早期预警中的准确率为 0.8232（特异度：0.6873，敏感度：0.9558），在诊断中的准确率为 0.9203（特异度：0.8776，敏感度：0.9720）。按照中国 DED 诊断标准，模型在早期预警中的准确率为 0.9584（特异度：0.9112，敏感度：0.9927），在诊断中的准确率为 0.9327（特异度：0.8742，敏感度：0.9851）。外部验证显示，早期预警和诊断的 AUC 分别为 0.910 和 0.957，以及 0.960 和 0.893。消融分析表明，结构化临床信息对诊断性能的贡献最强，而基于图像的信息提供了互补且可解释的眼表证据。结论：所提出的 DED-MLLM 在 DED 的早期预警和诊断中均显示出良好性能。

items.title: Concurrent de novo inference of cell types and gene regulatory networks with NetMap
items.abstract_or_text: Existing methods for GRN inference based on single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) data typically require prior cell type calling and then infer GRNs at cell type resolution. This risks propagation of errors from cell annotation to GRN inference. Moreover, it makes existing methods blind to regulatory programs that are shared between different cell types, as well as to subtle differences in regulatory activity between cells of the same type. To address these limitations, we present NetMap, a pipeline that jointly infers cell-level GRNs and clusters cells based on shared regulatory programs, combining state-of-the-art single-cell autoencoders and explainable artificial intelligence methods. NetMap outperforms existing methods on synthetic data with a known ground-truth GRN and is able to reliably detect biologically plausible regulons on real data. Moreover, requiring only a small set of user-provided marker genes, NetMap can be used for GRN structure-informed probabilistic cell type assignment. We demonstrate the utility of this approach using PBMC data, where we achieve near perfect clustering and cell type recovery performance compared with manually created cell type labels. Finally, we applied NetMap to a data set with naive, activated and exhausted T-cells, and were able to verify that NetMap retrieves relevant T-cell state signatures from the data, with two approaches. NetMap can be installed as a python package from https://github.com/bionetslab/netmap and is compatible with the scverse system. Scripts to reproduce our results can be found at https://github.com/bionetslab/netmap-evaluation.
items.summary_zh: NetMap 联合推断细胞级基因调控网络并按共享调控程序聚类，避免先做细胞类型标注造成的误差传播；在合成数据和 PBMC 数据上取得较好恢复，并提供可复现实验脚本。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把细胞类型推断和 GRN 推断合并为一个流程，并公开 Python 包和评估脚本，增强方法可复现性；真实数据证据仍主要是计算验证。
items.abstract_zh: 现有基于单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）数据进行基因调控网络（GRN）推断的方法，通常要求先确定细胞类型，然后在细胞类型分辨率上推断 GRN。这可能导致细胞注释误差传播到 GRN 推断中。此外，这种做法无法识别不同细胞类型之间共享的调控程序，也无法识别同一类型细胞之间调控活性的细微差异。为解决这些局限，我们提出 NetMap，这是一种联合推断细胞级 GRN 并根据共享调控程序对细胞进行聚类的流程，结合了先进的单细胞自编码器和可解释人工智能方法。NetMap 在具有已知真实 GRN 的合成数据上优于现有方法，并能够在真实数据中可靠检测具有生物学合理性的调控子。此外，只需用户提供少量标记基因，NetMap 就可用于基于 GRN 结构的概率性细胞类型分配。我们使用 PBMC 数据展示了该方法的实用性：与人工构建的细胞类型标签相比，NetMap 实现了接近完美的聚类和细胞类型恢复性能。最后，我们将 NetMap 应用于包含初始、激活和耗竭 T 细胞的数据集，并通过两种方法验证 NetMap 能够提取相关的 T 细胞状态特征。NetMap 可作为 Python 软件包安装，网址为 https://github.com/bionetslab/netmap，并兼容 scverse 系统。用于复现实验结果的脚本见 https://github.com/bionetslab/netmap-evaluation。

items.title: CRISCross: Integration of Epigenetic Information for Deep-Learning-Based Prediction of CRISPR-Cas9 Off-Targets Across Cell Types
items.abstract_or_text: CRISPR-Cas9 enables precise genome editing but remains limited by off-target effects, raising safety concerns and necessitating accurate prediction. Although epigenetic features influence Cas9 binding and cleavage, their predictive signals are often weak, highlyvariable, and context-dependent, limiting the effectiveness of existing machine learning approaches. Cross-cell-type settings are especially challenging: epigenetic landscapes differ substantially, and models trained on one cell type frequently fail to generalize. Here, we systematically investigate the role of epigenetic context in off-target prediction and demonstrate that its utility depends on modeling interactions with sequence features rather than treating it as an independent signal. Tabular and deep learning experiments demonstrate that epigenetic features provide a consistent but modestly complementary signal, and that late-stage fusion strategies are insufficient to effectively exploit this information. To address this, we introduce CRISCross, a cross-attention-based architecture that captures sequence-epigenetic interactions at the nucleotide level, alongside CRISPRAT, a synthetic pretraining strategy that learns transferable representations from genome-derived sgRNA-off-target pairs without relying on dataset-specific pretraining. CRISCross, incorporating AlphaGenome-derived chromatin accessibility signals, shows better predictive performance than sequence-only baselines across three independent test datasets spanning two cell types, demonstrating improved generalization across guide RNAs, datasets, and cellular contexts. This is particularly relevant for therapeutic applications involving cell types or patient-derived contexts that lack dedicated experimental datasets. In such settings, predicted chromatin accessibility may provide scalable contextual information when direct epigenomic profiling is unavailable or impractical. Together, these results show that accurate CRISPR off-target prediction benefits from interaction-aware integration of epigenetic context alongside generalizable pretraining strategies.
items.summary_zh: CRISCross 以跨注意力建模序列—表观遗传相互作用，并结合 CRISPRAT 合成预训练，在两个细胞类型的三个独立测试集上提升 CRISPR-Cas9 脱靶预测泛化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对细胞类型迁移这一安全关键问题，证明表观遗传信号需与序列交互建模；但性能提升仍来自计算测试，不能直接等同于体内安全性。
items.abstract_zh: CRISPR-Cas9 能够实现精准基因组编辑，但仍受到脱靶效应的限制，因此带来安全性问题并需要准确预测。尽管表观遗传特征会影响 Cas9 的结合和切割，但其预测信号通常较弱、高度可变且依赖具体情境，从而限制了现有机器学习方法的有效性。跨细胞类型场景尤其具有挑战性：不同细胞类型的表观遗传图谱差异很大，在一种细胞类型上训练的模型往往无法泛化。在此，我们系统研究了表观遗传背景在脱靶预测中的作用，并证明其效用取决于是否将其与序列特征之间的相互作用建模，而不是把它作为独立信号处理。表格模型和深度学习实验表明，表观遗传特征提供了稳定但幅度有限的互补信号，而后期融合策略不足以有效利用这一信息。为解决这一问题，我们提出 CRISCross，一种在核苷酸层面捕获序列—表观遗传相互作用的跨注意力架构；同时提出 CRISPRAT，一种合成预训练策略，通过从基因组衍生的 sgRNA—脱靶配对中学习可迁移表示，而不依赖数据集特异的预训练。结合 AlphaGenome 衍生染色质可及性信号的 CRISCross，在覆盖两种细胞类型的三个独立测试数据集上均优于仅使用序列的基线，在 guide RNA、数据集和细胞环境之间显示出更好的泛化能力。对于缺少专门实验数据的细胞类型或患者来源环境，这一点尤其具有意义。在这些场景中，当直接进行表观基因组分析不可用或不切实际时，预测的染色质可及性可以提供可扩展的情境信息。总体而言，这些结果表明，准确的 CRISPR 脱靶预测受益于对表观遗传背景的交互感知式整合，以及可泛化的预训练策略。

items.title: Microglia transcriptomic response to doxorubicin-induced genotoxic stress
items.abstract_or_text: Chemobrain, characterized by cognitive dysfunction, has emerged as a significant health concern following cancer treatment. Doxorubicin, an FDA-approved chemotherapeutic agent, is widely used to treat various cancers. However, its adverse effects raise concerns regarding toxicity in non-cancerous cell types. Microglia, the resident immune cells of the brain, play a central role in maintaining neural homeostasis. Despite this, the mechanisms by which microglia become dysfunctional following doxorubicin exposure remain poorly understood. Understanding the transcriptomic alterations induced by doxorubicin in microglia could provide critical insights into mechanisms underlying its neurotoxic effects. In this study, the transcriptomic response of human microglia to doxorubicin using mRNA sequencing combined with bioinformatic analysis was investigated. Exposure to doxorubicin significantly altered microglial morphology, promoting a shift toward a process-bearing phenotype in human HMC3 cells. This phenotypic change was accompanied by elevated levels of DNA damage and was associated with the induction of cellular senescence. At the gene regulation level, the Illumina-based transcriptomic analysis provided 25,834 gene expression profiling in which 5,669 were differentially expressed. The future analyses revealed that 3,431 (upregulated) and 2,238 (downregulated) were differentially expressed under the treatment of doxorubicin. Genes associated with the p53 signaling pathway and inflammatory responses were upregulated, whereas genes involved in translation, DNA replication, and cell-cycle progression were downregulated. This transcriptional dysregulation was accompanied by differential expression of key transcription factors. This study provides transcriptomic evidence elucidating the genotoxic response to doxorubicin in microglial cells, offering mechanistic insights into chemobrain and highlighting key molecular pathways as potential targets for therapeutic intervention.

items.title: DNA methylation-based prediction of differentiation state at cell-type resolution reveals an age-associated epigenetic mesenchymal drift
items.abstract_or_text: Quantifying the differentiation state of cells is an important task in regenerative medicine, cellular reprogramming and in elucidating how differentiation hierarchies are altered in aging and disease. For DNA methylation data (DNAm) there is however an accute shortage of methods for quantifying differentiation state. Here we use machine learning to build EpiDiff, a predictor of differentiation that yields a continuous absolute differentiation index (DI) when applied to a DNAm sample. We extensively validate EpiDiff in single-cells, sorted cells and bulk tissue, as well as in in-vitro differentiation, organoid, reprogramming and cellular rejuvenation experiments. In mixed samples, EpiDiff measures the extent of differentiation across all cellular lineages. In sorted cell populations, we find that DI increases with age and, underpinning this increase, we discover that many cell-types undergo a developmental epigenetic drift that is most prominent towards the mesenchymal lineage. When applied to normal-tissues, EpiDiff is predictive of carcinogenic exposure and cancer risk. In summary, EpiDiff is a unique, general and versatile tool that can accurately quantify the global differentiation state of a DNAm sample with broad applicability to many disciplines.

items.title: Clinical utility of plasma APOE proteotyping for Alzheimer's disease risk and prognosis
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a complex neurodegenerative disorder strongly influenced by genetic factors, with apolipoprotein E (APOE) {epsilon}4 allele being the most established risk variant. Although DNA-based genotyping remains standard, plasma proteotyping may provide scalable, isoform-specific alternatives. Methods: Plasma APOE4 protein were quantified using the NULISAseq CNS panel across four cohorts (ADRC, HeartSCORE, LATTICE, and ALPS). DNA-based APOE genotyping was the reference standard. Proteotyping thresholds for APOE {epsilon}4 carrier status and copy number were derived in ADRC and externally validated in the other cohorts. Logistic, proportional-odds, and Cox proportional-hazards models compared genotype- and proteotype-defined groups in relation to amyloid positivity, cross-sectional CDR global scores, and time to CDR-SB worsening, respectively. Results: Plasma APOE4 accurately classified APOE {epsilon}4 carrier status in ADRC (AUC=0.977, 95%CI 0.967-0.985; threshold 5.78 NULISA protein quantification [NPQ] value) and achieved near-perfect external validation in HeartSCORE, LATTICE, and ALPS (all AUCs=1.000, 95%CI 1.000-1.000). Plasma APOE4 also well-differentiated heterozygous from homozygous {epsilon}4 carriers (ADRC AUC=0.879, 95%CI 0.834-0.921; threshold 12.23 NPQ value). Genotype- and proteotype-defined {epsilon}4 carrier status showed similar associations with amyloid positivity (OR=4.40 vs 4.45), higher CDR global scores (OR=1.50 for both), and CDR-SB worsening (HR=1.22 for both). Discussion: Plasma APOE4 proteotyping accurately distinguished genotype-defined APOE {epsilon}4 carrier status and copy number while demonstrating AD-related associations comparable to DNA genotyping.

items.title: MESNet: A Lightweight Transformer-CNN Collaborative Network with Morphology Awareness for Glioma Segmentation
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Glioma segmentation is of great significance for clinical diagnosis and treatment, in which the effective utilization of multimodal information is crucial. Accurate segmentation holds substantial clinical value for guiding precise surgical resection, formulating personalized radiotherapy plans, and assessing prognosis. However, most existing methods focus primarily on the extraction and selection of deep semantic features while overlooking morphologically meaningful features such as edges and shapes. To address this issue, we propose a lightweight high-performance network named MESNet (Morphological Edge and Shape Network). MESNet is a Transformer–CNN collaborative segmentation model that explicitly imposes edge consistency and shape regularity to introduce morphological constraints, thereby enabling precise brain tumor segmentation. The model adopts an efficient 3D Transformer as its backbone, organically integrating convolutional neural networks to capture local details. Through deep complementarity between global context and fine-grained representations, it achieves accurate segmentation. To strengthen boundary awareness, a lightweight multi-scale edge-aware module is designed, which utilizes Sobel-based edge enhancement and spatial attention mechanisms to explicitly sharpen tumor boundaries, substantially reducing boundary errors without significantly increasing computational overhead. To accommodate irregular tumor morphology, an attention-guided shape-aware module is constructed; a zero-initialization strategy is employed to maintain training stability, and the module adaptively focuses on variations in tumor scale and shape, markedly improving the segmentation completeness and contour adherence of small targets such as enhancing tumors. Meanwhile, the network adheres to a lightweight design philosophy, strictly controlling parameter counts and computational complexity through channel compression and efficient attention mechanisms. Experimental results on the BraTS2021 dataset demonstrate that MESNet achieves overall segmentation accuracy and boundary agreement comparable to those of state-of-the-art methods while consuming substantially fewer resources, attaining a superior balance between efficiency and performance. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/tanjia123456/MESNet-main.

items.abstract_zh: 胶质瘤分割对于临床诊断和治疗具有重要意义，有效利用多模态信息至关重要。准确分割可为精准手术切除、个体化放疗方案制定和预后评估提供重要临床价值。然而，大多数现有方法主要关注深层语义特征的提取和选择，忽视了边缘和形状等具有形态学意义的特征。为此，我们提出一种名为 MESNet（Morphological Edge and Shape Network）的轻量级高性能网络。MESNet 是一种 Transformer-CNN 协同分割模型，通过显式施加边缘一致性和形状规整性来引入形态学约束，从而实现精确的脑肿瘤分割。该模型采用高效的 3D Transformer 作为骨干网络，并与卷积神经网络有机结合，以捕获局部细节。通过全局上下文与细粒度表示的深度互补，它实现了准确分割。为增强边界感知能力，我们设计了轻量级多尺度边缘感知模块，利用基于 Sobel 的边缘增强和空间注意力机制显式锐化肿瘤边界，在不显著增加计算开销的情况下大幅减少边界误差。为适应不规则肿瘤形态，我们构建了注意力引导的形状感知模块，并采用零初始化策略维持训练稳定性；该模块能够自适应关注肿瘤尺度和形状的变化，显著提高增强肿瘤等小目标的分割完整性和轮廓贴合度。同时，该网络遵循轻量化设计理念，通过通道压缩和高效注意力机制严格控制参数量和计算复杂度。BraTS2021 数据集上的实验结果表明，MESNet 获得了与当前先进方法相当的总体分割精度和边界一致性，同时消耗的资源显著更少，在效率和性能之间实现了更优平衡。源代码已公开，网址为 https://github.com/tanjia123456/MESNet-main。

items.title: Dementia Language Models: a generalizable and controllable representation of cognitive impairment
items.abstract_or_text: We introduce Dementia Language Models (DeLMs)--generalizable and controllable representations of cognitive impairment through language--alongside an evaluation framework for establishing their validity and clinical grounding. DeLMs created by fine-tuning large language models on a small clinical corpus successfully generated patient-like narratives across unseen tasks, received predicted Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) scores in the impaired range, and produced narratives that neurologists identified with accuracy comparable to real transcripts. The models' internal representations, as well as their non-linguistic decision-making, supported mild cognitive impairment detection in unseen cohorts. The effect was controllable: moving from Healthy toward Dementia in weight space progressively worsened language and predicted MMSE scores while increasing dementia probability. DeLMs could support clinician training, hypothesis generation, and scalable experimentation, reserving patient involvement for where it is truly needed.
